evidence: Authorize a bounded native object binding for the existing real BaseCurrentVehPacifismCount definition, not a new object or a changed support algorithm. Preserve its uint32_t source type, original support mapping and all claims. Observe its compiler symbol and verify initial data before publication.

Original storage is the separate initially zero DWORD at 90E980..90E984. Independent instruction/reference audit finds base_support as the only direct writer: reset 4E959F and increment store 4E9A76, with reads at 4E9A5F and 4E9AC4. The only external direct reads are base_psych at 4EAFBF, 4EB0CA and 4EB0E5.

Original psych at 4EB0CF compares this counter as signed against one; other psych additions and doubling retain 32-bit wrap. Implement explicit bit interpretation in the psych consumer, not an unsigned relational comparison or a source type change affecting support. Add bounded actual-body controls and remeasure protected base/vehicle/faction claims; this binding alone establishes no behavior or full acceptance.
